audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was shifted off its own whys. win[0]/win[1] read 'Tahm Kench' while whys[0]/[1] say Level 1 and Level 2 favour you; win[2] read 'Skill' while whys[2] says Level 3 is yours; win[3] read 'Skill' while whys[3] says Levels 4-5 flip to Tahm; win[4] read 'Dr. Mundo' while whys[4] calls Level 6 a skill wash.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Mundo, Mundo, Mundo, Tahm Kench, Skill, Mundo, Mundo — identical to the whys. Mundo out-ranges him (975 vs 900) with no resource cost while Tongue Lash costs 50 mana at rank 1, so the early poke war is genuinely his to lose.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Dr. Mundo, Levels 4-5 Tahm Kench, Level 6 Skill, both item stages Dr. Mundo. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Mundo's flip point ('press R mid-fight and regen half your HP') when it is the one stage neither champion owns, and breakdown.spikes listed his windows as Levels 1-2 rather than Levels 4-5.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s heal off missing health; Thick Skin converts stored damage into a shield on a 3s cooldown. Two sustain ultimates cancelling is a wash, not a spike.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states both cooldowns and calls it a wash; the spike calendar now names Levels 4-5 as his window.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why said 'your passive shrugs the first CC' as background colour without connecting it to anything. The decisive fact — Mundo's Goes Where He Pleases eats Tahm's first immobilise outright, so the 3-stack Tongue Lash stun does not land the way Tahm wants — was never used. Heart Zapper's heal condition and Abyssal Dive's real cooldown were also absent.
audit.why: Mundo passive resists the first immobilizing effect. Tahm Q applies An Acquired Taste and stuns only on the third stack, 7/6.5/6/5.5/5. Abyssal Dive 21/20/19/18/17, so 18s at rank 4. Mundo W heals only if the recast burst hits, 325 range.
audit.corrected: The passive is now stated as eating his first immobilise (with the caveat that it is one, not both), Abyssal Dive's 18s at rank 4 is given, and Heart Zapper's 325-range recast condition is written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was never mentioned against a champion who heals off Tongue Lash and regenerates stored damage through Thick Skin.
audit.why: Tahm Q flagged heal; Thick Skin passive heals from stored damage while out of combat — untouched grey health resets every trade otherwise.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and wants.you[2] now make Grievous Wounds the reason the first-item window is yours.

notes: Mirror tahmkench__drmundo already existed and is consistent with this: it records that Mundo eats Tahm's first immobilise outright and that Devour needs three An Acquired Taste stacks. Both directions now say Levels 1-3 are Mundo's, Levels 4-5 are Tahm's, and Level 6 is even. Kit-file oddity worth flagging: tahmkench.json lists Devour (R) with cd 0 and cost 100 — the cooldown is clearly not zero in game, so no R-cooldown claim was written anywhere in this proposal. breakdown.cooldowns states Abyssal Dive at 12s; the kit says 21/20/19/18/17. That block was left alone because its length band is dominated by templated summoner text, but the 12s figure is wrong on the live page and should be swept.
